sections.heading: THE REALITY
sections.body: A quick number is useful only if its inputs, formulas and limitations are visible. Visible methodologies, clearly labeled illustrative inputs and a link to the full calculator matter more than eye-catching but invented numerical outputs.

sections.heading: HOW TO APPROACH IT
sections.body: The Tools property should own full interactive calculators, assessments and methodologies. This gateway features only verifiably available utilities, with clear descriptions of what each does and does not calculate.

sections.heading: YOUR NEXT MOVE
